contract.causal_rule: a configured HMAC-attested clock contract, verified content-addressed raw archive, and source_timestamp_utc <= retrieved_utc <= observed_utc <= decision_cutoff_utc are required
contract.replay_rule: an as-of replay may use only immutable observations from the exact currently configured cohort and source-contract IDs, retrieved and observed no later than its decision cutoff
contract.window_rule: 15m and 60m changes require a same-source same-instrument prior observation within the configured clock tolerance; missing is unavailable
contract.revision_rule: a changed payload creates a new immutable version and never replaces the value known at an earlier cutoff
contract.no_data_policy: missing is unavailable, never zero or neutral
contract.material_change_policy: provider, instrument, parser, frequency, timestamp semantics, or access method changes require a new source cohort

sources.access_policy: do_not_bypass; request allow-list or ingest a permitted official export prospectively
sources.purpose: H4/H24 context only; never 15m/60m event repricing

official_release_transports.timestamp_policy: use authenticated message receipt and collector first-seen clocks; never substitute the scheduled release time
official_release_transports.purpose: direct policy-release transport, not rate-market repricing

blockers: no permitted timestamp-safe intraday OIS, policy-futures, or swap feed is connected
RBNZ direct policy pages and B2 file return HTTP 403 to the bounded collector
RBNZ official email updates require an explicit subscription and permitted mailbox connector
authoritative_notes: RBNZ states OCR decisions are published at 2pm NZT via its website, social media, Bloomberg/Refinitiv, and free email updates
RBNZ states its B2 wholesale rates are daily closing observations with a one-business-day publication lag
neither an official OCR level nor a daily closing curve is a substitute for market repricing inside a release window
